title: Beta 0.2.1 Hotfix
notes: This update adds an experimental Golkar interaction, reworked mobile UI interface and fixes a long list of gameplay bugs, mismatched achievements and leftover code.

NEW CONTENT
    • The Golkar faction screens now show three large letters, A (ABRI), B (Bureaucracy) and G (Golkar). Tap a letter to read about it and which decree breaks it.

NEW CAMPAIGN:
    • After choosing a difficulty, The Current Situation now asks whether you want the full briefing ("I want to learn what happened!!") or to start immediately ("Just let me play!")

MOBILE
    • A whole assortment of fixes and improvements..

GAMEPLAY FIXES
    • FINAL APPEALS: They now open on the Accountability Speech and the Night of the Long Knives, instead of being tied to the final turn, which has no action phase. Halo, Halo Senayan now needs two Final Appeals, the most a run can use.
    • VICTORY: Winning the vote now always requires 351 of 700 votes, even when factions were banned.
    • MILITARY: An effect that listed both mil and abri no longer applies both (no longer applies 2x the effect)
    • DECREES: Mutually exclusive decrees now block each other in both directions.
    • ACHIEVEMENTS: Voice of the People now unlocks at the "Tolerated" popularity tier it names.
FIXES: Fixed the music player not looping when only one track is available in a genre, and a misspelled style name on the vote result paper. Removed legacy codes.

title: Beta 0.2 "Rekayasa Politik"
notes: This version introduces Indonesian localization alongside a major rework of difficulty, opposition mechanics, gameplay balance, UI, music, and code cleanup.

NEW CONTENT
    • SEVERE STATE SITUATIONS (SSS): Beat Historical to unlock a 24-card custom crisis board. Win with every situation card at Level III to unlock the Bragging Rights achievement.
    • PDI-P OPPOSITION: Added a Street Mobilization bar to the PDI-P faction screen.
    • MILITARY OPPOSITION: Added a Patience and Anger bar to the Military faction screen.
    • ACHIEVEMENTS: Expanded to 66 achievements (31 new) across reformist, authoritarian, stat, and faction paths, and fixed the Bragging Rights unlock trigger.
    • MUSIC PLAYER: Added genre filters (National, Critique, Pop, International) and direct seek and volume sliders on the dashboard.

DIFFICULTY
    Updated and reworked. Beyond starting Political Capital, Cendana Influence, Maluses, PC action costs, and military anger, each difficulty now also scales delegate defection rates, chamber volatility, event outcomes, and faction leverage:

    • Easy: 75 PC, +15 to starting stats, Cendana at 40. Decrees and faction deals cost 10% less, bad events hurt 25% less, and faction deals pay 15% more.
    • Medium: 50 PC, +5 to stats, Cendana at 60, +1 PC/turn. Good events are 8% stronger and faction deals pay 15% more.
    • High: 35 PC, no stat bonus, Cendana at 75. Slightly higher action costs, bad events hit 5% harder, and Cendana slowly regenerates.
    • Historical: 20 PC, Cendana at 95, +15% action costs (+2 PC on every faction deal). Bad events hit 10% harder, good events are 5% weaker, favors are capped at 2 per faction, and all cooldowns last 1 turn longer.

GAMEPLAY
    • STATS: Faction support above baseline slowly erodes each turn unless maintained, high stats gravitate toward neutral (and low stats nudge upward on Easy/Medium), and Cendana regenerates toward its starting strength.
    • ELECTION: Added difficulty-scaled mood swings, wildcard shocks, aisle-crossing, and secret-ballot betrayal during the final vote.
    • LEVERAGE: Faction leverage now scales cost and gain multipliers gradually instead of jumping at fixed tiers.
    • DECREES: Stat and loyalty floors guaranteed by decrees now ramp up each turn instead of locking instantly.
    • ROUTINE: Repeating the same Routine Action or Faction Deal now yields diminishing PC and weaker effects.
    • FAVORS: Banked favors per faction are now capped by difficulty.

REBALANCE
    • ACTIONS & EVENTS: Reworked Decrees, Routine Actions, Faction Deals, and Events to fit the new difficulty curve, nerfed overpowered options, and softened Medium difficulty.
    • OPPOSITION: Balanced Military and PDI-P impacts across events and actions; extreme decrees now deal direct shock to Military patience, while high Military loyalty slows and drains anger.
    • POLITICAL CAPITAL: Capped passive PC earnings at 10 PC, made stability maluses take a proportional share of routine PC gains instead of a flat cut, and capped combined Military/PDI-P PC reductions at 40%.

UI & CLEANUP
    • VISUALS: Added new themes (Merah Putih, Rainbow, Rainbow swirl, Twilight, Kopi, Solarized), added a glossy glass overlay to images, enlarged the "In Memoriam photo," and colored Poros Tengah green once formed.
    • TEXT & ALERTS: Trimmed events, factions, and decrees to two paragraphs max, justified faction descriptions, standardized all stat names, and color-coded meter text and new-interaction alerts.
    • UNDER THE HOOD: Cleaned up Library formatting, unified stat and stance strings for localization, removed legacy loading/tooltip code, and fixed minor bugs and typos.

REMOVED
    • Removed the Cilangkap Pact, achievement images, and the street mobilization line and tooltips from the presidential agenda.

title: Beta 0.1.1 Hotfix
notes: Amien Rais and Gus Dur will no longer blindly hand you the presidency: Coalition favors are now taxed on merge, and final appeal favor-dumping has heavy diminishing returns.
Infinite PC button patched: Slashed base Political Capital payouts across routine actions so you can't just print 300+ PC like an ATM.

PDI-P will literally burn the capital down and then crucify you: Freezing out Megawati into deep hostility now triggers massive red-shirt demonstrations, bleeding National Stability and spooking regional delegates.
  • Added a 'Street Mobilization' indicator to PDI-P's screen so you can see how close the Satgas is to rioting before things explode.
Cendana actually does something instead of sleeping: Nuking Suharto's family influence too fast in a single turn now causes liquidity runs and street-level sabotage.
Reunifying Golkar under Slipi sets a reasonable floor instead of permanently making him 100% loyal.
